scope: Independent static review of the listed API private-storage/production changes only
result: No remaining actionable issue found in the final reviewed delta

findings.issue: Protected audit export files originally bypassed document symlink/hardlink/owner/permission controls
findings.status: Resolved by shared O_NOFOLLOW/exclusive private I/O and fstat validation; first export snapshot remains stable and parsed/hashed from one exact byte buffer

findings.issue: Owner-only directory preflight originally accepted owner modes without write/traverse access
findings.status: Resolved by mode0700 and read/write/execute access checks; preflight stays read-only

findings.issue: Retained audit export downloads originally bypassed the optional reader disabled state and production export-directory checks
findings.status: Resolved by explicit auditReader/verifyConfiguredAuditReader on download and no production audit-directory fallback

reviewedControls: Production absolute storage outside checkout; lexical and realpath containment checks
Directory owner, mode0700, no leaf directory symlink, effective read/write/execute access
Bounded safe UUID-style object names and64hex audit JSON names; no path separators/traversal
O_EXCL/O_NOFOLLOW creation; O_NOFOLLOW reads and fstat regular-file/owner/single-link/group-other checks
Immutable document bytes and first-snapshot audit retries preserved separately
Dedicated optional audit reader remains required; production audit plaintext TLS rejected
Startup/release preflights remain read-only; no database grant or provider fallback introduced

validation.method: Source and test review, final delta reread and whitespace check only
validation.apiTests: Root-owned run; this review does not claim its outcome

limitations: No production credentials, hosted database, private records or real volumes inspected.
Durability, encryption, backup/retention, provider configuration and installed-device acceptance remain external requirements.
Filesystem checks assume the operating-system account and volume custody are trusted.
